field.name: advice
field.p: Take your medicines every day, check your sugar as advised, walk 30 minutes most days, check your feet daily and have your eyes examined once a year. Come back at once if your sugar stays above 300 or you feel very weak or confused.

field.name: advice
field.p: Take your medicines every day even when you feel well, reduce salt, keep a healthy weight and measure your blood pressure at home. Come back at once for chest pain, severe headache or weakness of one side.

field.name: advice
field.p: Take your medicine at the same time every day, eat less fried and fatty food, and stay active.

field.name: advice
field.p: Take the thyroid tablet on an empty stomach, 30 minutes before breakfast, every day.

field.name: advice
field.p: Avoid painkillers like ibuprofen and diclofenac unless your doctor allows them, and follow the diet advice for salt and potassium.
